surface: Final six-specialty review of the Handrail Z-fold proposal, reading paths, notes and tailored resume
acceptedDecisions: True Z-fold, continuous camera movement, opposite-depth wings, fine paper texture, crease shading and soft projected light.
Telescope scale changes, Igloo camera continuity, Exat typography and Stripe Press document presentation remain approved references.
Preserve the official Handrail wordmark, warm paper/rust palette and locally served Inter/Playfair typography.
Remove decorative Unicode arrows, emojis and ornamental symbols; no paperclip or separate decorative sculpture.
Lead with the beginning of a partnership and growing Handrail; new business is a starting point and Brent’s contribution can grow with company needs.
Keep no base salary and commission paid after customer collections, with matching installments.
Keep 15/5 if hired first and 20/5 if the qualifying client comes first, including that client and all future credited sales.
Keep the 90-day proposal and benefits request. Handrail writes the final contract; no named future roles or private financial problems appear.
Continue the approved local design, Storybook and Playwright workflow.
Use mobile ink hierarchy rather than extra opacity/filter layers; active text stays full strength.
Require an independent adversarial design critic for mobile camera/layout changes; record and resolve blockers before publication.
Six complete phone reading scenes and five desktop scenes follow the visible three-panel overview.
Equal collected-dollar comparison for15% and20%, with cash remaining before delivery/benefits/other costs.
Physical crease orbits, bounded surfaces, stable ink and same-document reading.
Evidence-backed resume with2025degree, proposed contribution areas and decorative Handrail watermark.
Prominent resume/GitHub links, responsive navigation and exact history-entry return position.
rejectedDecisions: Published paper sculpture and clip treatment rejected by user after live review.
Full contract framing and legal boilerplate; replacement must be a negotiable business proposal.
The published flat flyer improved the direction but did not provide enough dynamic motion; replace it with a real hinged trifold.

implementation.camera: Native scroll drives one critically damped GSAP ticker and a pure continuous cubic camera path; logarithmic zoom and camera-facing reading poses preserve accordion depth.

Remove decorative symbols and preserve the official Handrail brand.
Present a practical beginning to a broader partnership without limiting Brent to sales forever or promising a specific future position.
Preserve the original economic terms and proposal-not-contract framing.
Pull the phone camera back and keep associated headings and explanations together.
Reserve actual header/control clearances and refit after height changes while preserving place.
Subdue surrounding print so the active reading group remains the focal point.
